result.summary: Read PLAN.md (§1-2) and r3/analysis.md (full), extracted the four literature topics from §6: L1 (conditional screen-then-sort / "合取" constructs, targeting §5.3's N mission and core-1 periphery), L2 (detecting when a new feature is a nonlinear transform of a known control variable, targeting §2.2's falsification), L3 (higher moments / extremes of a stock's own volume or intraday-dispersion series as a cross-sectional feature, targeting core 2 / §2.5), L4 (intraday volatility tail relative to a stock's own average, targeting §2.6). For each, ran WebSearch (and some WebFetch/secondary verification) restricted to pre-2023-08-08 publications, translated literature treatments into the project's operator language, and reported genuine search gaps honestly rather than fabricating citations. Wrote the result to r3/lit.md via the Write tool (succeeded, no Bash-heredoc fallback needed), with per-topic findings, operational translations, an explicit "搜不到" subsection per topic, a 20-row source table (S1-S20) with verified:true/false flags and caveats (two textbook sources flagged as weaker than peer-reviewed evidence; one working paper's authorship not fully confirmed; one journal volume number inferred rather than confirmed), and a closing PI summary distinguishing well-supported operational suggestions from genuine literature gaps. Confirmed file on disk (40447 bytes) via ls -l.
